definitions.gloss: rice husk; rice chaff; rice hull
definitions.explanation: The dry, papery outer hull separated from rice grains during hulling. Often used as mulch, fuel, or packing material.

examples.japanese: {籾殻|もみがら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧まく。
examples.english: I spread rice husks on the field.

examples.japanese: {籾殻|もみがら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{燃料|ねんりょう}→燃料：13461_nenryou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Rice husks are also used as fuel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{籾殻|もみがら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{運|はこ}んだ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: In the old days, eggs were carried packed in rice husks.

notes:
The dry, papery outer hull of a rice grain, separated from the rice during hulling. Composed of ⟦{籾|もみ}→籾：27969_momi⟧ (unhulled rice) + ⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧ (husk, shell).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{肥料|ひりょう}→肥料：06102_hiryou⟧: fertilizer / soil conditioner
- ⟦{燃料|ねんりょう}→燃料：13461_nenryou⟧: fuel
- ⟦{緩衝材|かんしょうざい}→緩衝材：18884_kanshouzai⟧: cushioning / packing material

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{糠|ぬか}→糠：29202_nuka⟧: rice bran — the powdery layer beneath the husk, removed when polishing rice
- ⟦{籾|もみ}→籾：27969_momi⟧: unhulled rice — rice still in its husk
